kvkk.title: General Privacy Notice Regarding the Processing of Personal Data
kvkk.intro: we attach great importance to ensuring the security of your personal data. In this context, we take all necessary technical and administrative measures in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK Law").
kvkk.section1Title: 1. Obtaining, Processing and Purposes of Your Personal Data
kvkk.section1Text: Your personal data is processed for purposes such as conducting company activities, fulfilling legal requirements, security, marketing, customer relations, and meeting legal obligations.
kvkk.identityInfoDesc: Information from documents such as ID cards, passports
kvkk.customerInfoDesc: Information obtained within the scope of commercial relations
kvkk.transactionSecurityInfoDesc: Technical data for conducting commercial activities
kvkk.riskManagementInfoDesc: Data for managing commercial and administrative risks
kvkk.financialInfoDesc: All types of financial information, documents and records
kvkk.section2Text: Your personal data may be shared with company affiliates, business partners, suppliers, public institutions and authorized private individuals in accordance with Articles 8 and 9 of the KVKK Law for the purposes stated above.
kvkk.section3Text: Data is deleted, destroyed or anonymized in accordance with Article 7 of the KVKK Law at the end of the periods determined by legislation or required by the nature of the work.
kvkk.section4Title: 4. Your Rights Regarding the Processing of Personal Data
kvkk.section4Text: As a personal data owner, you have the following rights under Article 11 of the KVKK Law:
kvkk.right1: Learning whether your data is being processed
kvkk.right2: Requesting information if it has been processed
kvkk.right4: Requesting correction of incomplete or incorrect data
kvkk.right5: Requesting deletion or destruction of data
kvkk.right6: Requesting notification to transferred third parties
kvkk.right7: Objecting to results of automated analysis
kvkk.right8: Requesting compensation for damages due to unlawful processing
kvkk.section5Text: To exercise your rights above, you can apply using the "Personal Data Protection Application Form" through one of the following methods:
kvkk.applicationMethod1: Hand delivery to Yunus Emre Mah. Lütfi Aykaç Blv. No:80 Sultangazi/İstanbul
kvkk.responseTime: A response will be given within 30 days at the latest from the date the request reaches our company. Additional information may be requested from the applicant if necessary. Also, if the response incurs costs, the fee determined by the KVKK Board may be charged.
kvkk.moreInfo: For detailed information, please contact us.

aboutUs.contentDescription: NATA Living, backed by Nata Holding, goes beyond being just a brand that develops residential projects. We create modern and sustainable projects that touch every aspect of life. Across Turkey, we offer a diverse portfolio ranging from residential, villa, office, commercial spaces, and shopping malls to tourism, healthcare, and social living spaces, presenting tomorrow's urban planning vision today.
aboutUs.qualityTitle: Quality and Trust in Every Project
aboutUs.qualityDescription: As NATA Living, our priority is to provide high living standards to our residents while offering aesthetics and functionality together. We make a difference in the industry with quality materials, innovative architectural approaches, and environmentally friendly solutions used in our projects.
aboutUs.point1Description: From Ankara to Bodrum, from Milas to Turkey's rising regions, our projects provide great advantages for both living and investment with their central locations, transportation ease, and social facilities. We have a wide portfolio from residential, office, commercial, and mall concepts to exclusive villa projects and tourism-focused living spaces.
aboutUs.point2Description: We always aim to exceed our customers' expectations, becoming a trusted solution partner with the professional services we provide before and after sales. With transparent communication, fast support, and personalized solutions, we are always by your side in your investment journey.
aboutUs.point3Description: NATA Living considers its environmental and social responsibilities while producing projects that add value to the future. We open the doors to a sustainable life with our structures that are in harmony with nature and have high energy efficiency.
aboutUs.galleryDescription: You can find photos from our company's office below. Discover our modern, elegant, and functional spaces.

salesNetwork.heroTitle:
Welcome to Our
Authorized Sales Network Portal
salesNetwork.contentDescription:
NATA LIVING's powerful portfolio is now under one roof.
Nata Living has established a new ecosystem that offers its real estate portfolio from a single center for selected professionals.
This ecosystem is not just an access area, but a new approach that will shape the functioning of the sector.
We are bringing a new discipline to real estate sales processes with a digital, transparent and fully controllable CRM infrastructure.
Now all transactions are carried out under one order, one system and one standard.
The NATA LIVING era is beginning for professional real estate experts.
This new sales network, which offers direct access to our corporate portfolio, is designed to take your trust, speed and service quality to the next level.
Join the NATA LIVING Authorized Sales Network. Strengthen your portfolio.
salesNetwork.aboutPortalDescription:
The Nata Living Authorized Sales Network Portal is a new ecosystem that brings together real estate sales processes in one center.
So how does this system work?
The system combines Residential, Office, and Commercial Space portfolios in a single database.
This portfolio is opened in a controlled manner to selected professional real estate offices throughout Turkey.
When professional real estate consultants log into this portal, they directly access all listings, current prices, project details, and sales documents.
Customer registration, offer creation, reservation requests, and contract processes are completely managed through NATA LIVING CRM.
The system also has a special approval mechanism. Every transaction is digitally controlled by NATA LIVING's central teams.
This guarantees price stability, correct information flow, and a standard sales process.
Access to a strong portfolio, fast information flow, accurate data, and a professional sales order managed from a single center. As a result,
The NATA LIVING Authorized Sales Network offers a new digital business model that makes real estate sales easily accessible, systematic, reliable, and much more efficient.

incek.lifeDescription: With the view of Lake Mogan and its nature-integrated location, Nata İncek is the address of ideal living on a 16,000 m² area, of which 12,000 m² is green space. Offering spacious, stylish and functional living spaces that make your life easier, the project consists of 160 residences in 4 blocks of 22 floors (basement + ground floor), along with 11 shops and social facilities. While each apartment has 2 dedicated indoor parking spaces, social amenities such as a fitness center, sauna, Turkish bath, swimming pool, children's playgrounds and walking tracks await you for a comfortable life. The entire site is safely monitored 24/7 with a CCTV system.
